table_query:
SELECT
  CAST(date_format(d, 'yyyyMMdd') AS INT) AS DateKey,
  d                                       AS FullDate,
  year(d)                                 AS Year,
  quarter(d)                              AS Quarter,
  month(d)                                AS Month,
  date_format(d, 'MMMM')                  AS MonthName,
  day(d)                                  AS Day,
  dayofweek(d)                            AS DayOfWeek,
  date_format(d, 'EEEE')                  AS DayName,
  dayofweek(d) IN (1, 7)                  AS IsWeekend,
  weekofyear(d)                           AS WeekOfYear,
  CAST(date_format(d, 'yyyyMM') AS INT)   AS YearMonth
FROM (SELECT explode(sequence(DATE'2000-01-01', DATE'2035-12-31', INTERVAL 1 DAY)) AS d)
column_expressions: CAST(UNHEX(SHA2(CONCAT(IFNULL(CAST(`FullDate` AS STRING), 'NULL'), '|', IFNULL(CAST(`Year` AS STRING), 'NULL'), '|', IFNULL(CAST(`Quarter` AS STRING), 'NULL'), '|', IFNULL(CAST(`Month` AS STRING), 'NULL'), '|', IFNULL(CAST(`MonthName` AS STRING), 'NULL'), '|', IFNULL(CAST(`Day` AS STRING), 'NULL'), '|', IFNULL(CAST(`DayOfWeek` AS STRING), 'NULL'), '|', IFNULL(CAST(`DayName` AS STRING), 'NULL'), '|', IFNULL(CAST(`IsWeekend` AS STRING), 'NULL'), '|', IFNULL(CAST(`WeekOfYear` AS STRING), 'NULL'), '|', IFNULL(CAST(`YearMonth` AS STRING), 'NULL')), 256)) AS BINARY)
create_table_ddl:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS gold.yagoldmodel2.DimDate (
  `DateKey` INT,
  `FullDate` DATE,
  `Year` INT,
  `Quarter` INT,
  `Month` INT,
  `MonthName` STRING,
  `Day` INT,
  `DayOfWeek` INT,
  `DayName` STRING,
  `IsWeekend` BOOLEAN,
  `WeekOfYear` INT,
  `YearMonth` INT,
  `SurrogateKey` BINARY,
  `SurrogateKey_Id` BIGINT,
  Audit_CreatedDateTime TIMESTAMP,
  Audit_ModifiedDateTime TIMESTAMP,
  ChangeHash BINARY
)
USING delta
